subject: return(NULL) in image outputs displays broken image in Firefox 27

messages.author: e148739acb00308d
messages.subject: return(NULL) in image outputs displays broken image in Firefox 27
parts: The latest update to Firefox displays image outputs (such as plots) as a broken image for anything where src="NULL" (i.e., when you use a return(NULL) or return(invisible()) to hide outputs when a certain condition is not met). Is there another way to handle such conditions so the output doesn't show at all, rather than resulting in an image with src="NULL"?

messages.author: e148739acb00308d
messages.subject: Re: return(NULL) in image outputs displays broken image in Firefox 27
parts:
I should also add that this appears to only happen on spark; when I run the app locally in Firefox the src is populated with a blank png, so no broken image. In both cases I'm running Shiny 0.8.0.

Here's an example: http://spark.rstudio.com/usimpact/null/
